en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, and from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr Al-Zayyāt, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, who said:
I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: Allāh will register those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights among those (who will be) in A’lā ‘Illīyyīn.
